_comment: Golden master (T-230): sha256 of the full ROM built from each FROZEN corpus bundle, on the PRO build box. build(frozen_bundle) is byte-deterministic (T-231/GATE-2), so a hash match proves the build output is unchanged. This is a POINT-IN-TIME snapshot: Phase-3 injection must reproduce these hashes byte-for-byte (INV-BYTES, base unchanged); a Phase-2 base refactor changes the bytes by design (INV-BEHAVIOR) and RE-SNAPSHOTS this file. Hashes are valid only for this base ROM + toolchain + core-count; an upstream sync or toolchain change requires regenerating. See docs/base-plus-injection-strategy.md.
baseline: post-T239 (Group A injected). Same fixed-capacity layout as the post-T237/T-247 base, plus one base change: GetItemTMHMMoveId() reads gTMHMItemMoveIds instead of a switch generated from FOREACH_TM, so the TM list is DATA and can be injected (T-239). Bytes changed BY DESIGN vs the post-T237 snapshot (INV-BEHAVIOR). Re-snapshotted 2026-08-02 alongside a GATE-3 run: every table the group-a-fixed module writes matches compile() by symbol on all 12 corpus ROMs. NB B-057 — a compiled ROM's LAYOUT drifts with the data it carries, so these hashes are the compile path's own regression net, not the injection reference; the injection gate is parity.mjs --by-symbol.

injectableSymbols._note: offsets are for THIS base build; randomization shifts them — read each build's own .map. Inject only into the fixed base.

gRandomizerSettings.layout: u32 trainerMoneyNormal, trainerMoneyBoss, trainerMoneyGym, moveRelearnerCost (T-234, via GetRandomizerSettings noipa accessor)

gGymRewards.layout: 11 x { u16 species, u16 item } (T-235, via GetGymReward special)

gStaticEncounters.layout: 7 x { u16 species, u16 level } — regirock/regice/registeel/mew/legend1-3 (T-235, via SetupStaticEncounter special)

gItemPicks.layout: 53 x { u16 items[4] } — 0..28 randomizer-filled item locations, 29..52 STATIC TM picks (T-236, via GetItemPickItem / BufferItemPickName specials)

gMegaTrainerHidden.layout: 21 x u8 bool — index = MEGA_TRAINERS id - 1; TRUE hides that mega's trainer NPC + stone ball at spawn (T-236, via RandomizerIsHiddenMegaObject)

gLocationNicknames.layout: 160 x { u8 mapGroup, mapNum, gender, nickname[13] } = 16 B rows (T-237); gLocationNicknameCount says how many are real, read via the GetLocationNicknameCount noipa accessor

gLocationNicknameCount.layout: u8 — number of real gLocationNicknames rows; 0 = feature off (T-237, noipa accessor)

gTradeNicknames.layout: 8 x { u8 tradeId, u8 nickname[13] } = 16 B rows (T-237); see gTradeNicknameCount

gTradeNicknameCount.layout: u8 — number of real gTradeNicknames rows; 0 = feature off (T-237, noipa accessor)

gStarterMon.layout: 3 x u16 species (T-237, via the GetStarterPokemon noipa accessor)

gStarterExtraMon.layout: 16 x u16 species — STARTER_EXTRA_CAPACITY slots; gStarterExtraCount says how many are real (T-237)

gStarterNickname.layout: u8[13] inline name for the chosen starter (T-237)

gStarterGender.layout: u8 forced gender for the chosen starter (T-237, noipa accessor)

gStarterExtraCount.layout: u8 — how many of the 16 extra-starter slots are real (T-237, via GetExtraPokemonCount noipa accessor)

gIngameTrades.layout: 4 x struct InGameTrade — fixed width; requestedSpeciesList / requestedBaseForms are inline u16[16] with their counts (T-237)

gTrainers.layout: [DIFFICULTY_COUNT][860] struct Trainer (0x30 B each); .party points at a party padded to TRAINER_PARTY_CAPACITY (6 x 36 B = 216 B), so parties are overwritten in place through that pointer (T-237)

_learnsets.romOffset: per-species — look each array up by name in the base build's .map
_learnsets.layout: 1104 level-up learnsets at LEVEL_UP_LEARNSET_CAPACITY (44 x 4 B = 176 B stride) + 1101 teachable learnsets at TEACHABLE_LEARNSET_CAPACITY (80 x 2 B = 160 B stride); both exported non-static so the .map locates them by name (T-237)
